------------------------- MODULE W4Od9m0p5t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS N, C, MaxVer

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 1 /\ C \in Nat /\ C >= 1 /\ MaxVer \in Nat

Feeders     == 1 .. N
Controllers == 1 .. C
Idle        == 0

VARIABLES shed, ver, attempt, shedLog

vars == << shed, ver, attempt, shedLog >>

Init ==
    /\ shed     = [f \in Feeders |-> FALSE]
    /\ ver      = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ attempt  = [c \in Controllers |-> [fdr |-> Idle, rv |-> 0]]
    /\ shedLog  = << >>

Begin(c) ==
    /\ attempt[c].fdr = Idle
    /\ \E f \in Feeders :
        /\ ~shed[f]
        /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![c] = [fdr |-> f, rv |-> ver[f]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << shed, ver, shedLog >>

Commit(c) ==
    LET f == attempt[c].fdr IN
    /\ f # Idle
    /\ ~shed[f]
    /\ attempt[c].rv = ver[f]
    /\ shed'    = [shed  EXCEPT ![f] = TRUE]
    /\ ver'     = [ver   EXCEPT ![f] = @ + 1]
    /\ shedLog' = Append(shedLog, f)
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![c] = [fdr |-> Idle, rv |-> 0]]

Retry(c) ==
    LET f == attempt[c].fdr IN
    /\ f # Idle
    /\ attempt[c].rv # ver[f]
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![c] = [fdr |-> f, rv |-> ver[f]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << shed, ver, shedLog >>

AdminForce ==
    \E f \in Feeders :
        /\ ~shed[f]
        /\ shed'    = [shed EXCEPT ![f] = TRUE]
        /\ ver'     = [ver  EXCEPT ![f] = @ + 1]
        /\ shedLog' = Append(shedLog, f)
        /\ UNCHANGED attempt

Reconfigure ==
    \E f \in Feeders :
        /\ ~shed[f]
        /\ ver[f] < MaxVer
        /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![f] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED << shed, attempt, shedLog >>

Abort(c) ==
    /\ attempt[c].fdr # Idle
    /\ shed[attempt[c].fdr]
    /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![c] = [fdr |-> Idle, rv |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << shed, ver, shedLog >>

AllSettled ==
    /\ \A f \in Feeders : shed[f]
    /\ \A c \in Controllers : attempt[c].fdr = Idle

Terminate ==
    /\ AllSettled
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Begin(c) \/ Commit(c) \/ Retry(c) \/ Abort(c)
    \/ AdminForce
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Terminate

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ShedAtMostOnce ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN shedLog :
        (i # j) => (shedLog[i] # shedLog[j])
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 2
    C = 2
    MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ShedAtMostOnce
nl:
A regional power-grid load shedder must trip feeders to avoid a cascade during an overload. Shedding a feeder is physically irreversible: once a breaker opens it must be logged and never opened a second time in the same event. Several independent controllers race to shed feeders, so each controller uses optimistic locking: it reads the feeder's configuration version, prepares the trip, and only commits if the version is still unchanged, otherwise it re-reads and retries. Background reconfiguration keeps bumping feeder versions, which forces controllers to retry when their read is stale. A privileged grid operator can invoke an admin override that force-trips a feeder immediately, bypassing the optimistic check. Every successful trip appends the feeder to a shed log. The controllers and the override must never open the same breaker twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No feeder appears more than once in the shed log, so the irreversible trip action happens at most once per feeder.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m6p0t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Machines, LeaseLen, MaxT

ASSUME LeaseLen \in Nat /\ LeaseLen >= 1 /\ MaxT \in Nat

NoOwner == "none"

VARIABLES clock, owner, deadline, occupants, reqs

vars == << clock, owner, deadline, occupants, reqs >>

Init ==
    /\ clock     = 0
    /\ owner     = NoOwner
    /\ deadline  = 0
    /\ occupants = {}
    /\ reqs      = {}

LeaseValid == owner \in Machines /\ deadline > clock

SubmitReq ==
    \E m \in Machines :
        /\ reqs' = reqs \cup {m}
        /\ UNCHANGED << clock, owner, deadline, occupants >>

GrantLease ==
    \E m \in reqs :
        /\ ~LeaseValid
        /\ occupants = {}
        /\ owner'    = m
        /\ deadline' = clock + LeaseLen
        /\ reqs'     = reqs \ {m}
        /\ UNCHANGED << clock, occupants >>

EnterDock ==
    /\ owner \in Machines
    /\ deadline > clock
    /\ owner \notin occupants
    /\ occupants' = occupants \cup {owner}
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, owner, deadline, reqs >>

LeaveDock ==
    \E m \in occupants :
        /\ occupants' = occupants \ {m}
        /\ UNCHANGED << clock, owner, deadline, reqs >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ occupants = {}
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, deadline, occupants, reqs >>

Halt ==
    /\ clock = MaxT
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == SubmitReq \/ GrantLease \/ EnterDock \/ LeaveDock \/ Tick \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DockMutualExclusion ==
    \A a, b \in occupants : a = b
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Machines = {m1, m2}
    LeaseLen = 2
    MaxT = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DockMutualExclusion
nl:
A network of vending machines shares a single refrigerated restocking dock that only one machine may physically occupy at a time. Access is arbitrated by short-lived leases: a machine asks a lease service for the dock, and the service grants a lease stamped with an expiry deadline. Because the acquire requests travel over an unreliable bus, they can be delivered and processed in any order, so the service picks pending requests non-deterministically rather than first-come. A machine may occupy the dock only while it holds a lease that has not yet expired, and it must vacate before the service hands the dock to anyone else. Time advances a global clock, and leases silently expire when the clock passes their deadline. The service will only grant a fresh lease when the previous one is invalid and the dock is physically empty. The whole point is that the dock is never shared.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one vending machine occupies the restocking dock at any instant, so all machines currently in the dock are the same machine.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m7p5t2 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cars, Stalls

Free == 0

VARIABLES reg, waxed, waxLog, ready

vars == << reg, waxed, waxLog, ready >>

Init ==
    /\ reg    = [s \in Stalls |-> Free]
    /\ waxed  = [c \in Cars |-> FALSE]
    /\ waxLog = << >>
    /\ ready  = Cars

Owns(c) == \E s \in Stalls : reg[s] = c

ClaimStall ==
    \E c \in ready, s \in Stalls :
        /\ reg[s] = Free
        /\ ~Owns(c)
        /\ reg'   = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = c]
        /\ ready' = ready \ {c}
        /\ UNCHANGED << waxed, waxLog >>

ApplyWax ==
    \E s \in Stalls :
        /\ reg[s] # Free
        /\ ~waxed[reg[s]]
        /\ waxed'  = [waxed EXCEPT ![reg[s]] = TRUE]
        /\ waxLog' = Append(waxLog, reg[s])
        /\ UNCHANGED << reg, ready >>

ReleaseStall ==
    \E s \in Stalls :
        /\ reg[s] # Free
        /\ waxed[reg[s]]
        /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
        /\ UNCHANGED << waxed, waxLog, ready >>

AllDone ==
    /\ ready = {}
    /\ \A s \in Stalls : reg[s] = Free

Idle == AllDone /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == ClaimStall \/ ApplyWax \/ ReleaseStall \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Occurrences(c) == Cardinality({ i \in DOMAIN waxLog : waxLog[i] = c })

WaxAtMostOnce == \A c \in Cars : Occurrences(c) <= 1
=============================================================================
nl:
Two independent car-wash conveyor lines feed cars into one shared pool of wax stalls. Each stall has a compare-and-swap ownership register that is either free or holds exactly one car; a line claims a stall for a waiting car by a CAS that succeeds only when the register reads free. Once a car owns a stall it receives a hot-wax coat, which is a one-time irreversible finish that must never be applied twice to the same car. After waxing, the car releases its stall, returning the register to free so another waiting car from either line can claim it. Because both lines draw from the same stall pool, two cars can be contending for the same free register at once, and only one CAS may win. Every wax application is recorded in an append-only finish log. The finish log must never contain the same car twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No car appears more than once in the wax finish log, so the irreversible wax action is applied at most once per car.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m9p1t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS K, MaxEpoch, MaxTotal

ASSUME K \in Nat /\ K >= 1 /\ MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxTotal \in Nat

Cranes == 1 .. K

VARIABLES epoch, record, contributed, adminAdded, inflight

vars == << epoch, record, contributed, adminAdded, inflight >>

Init ==
    /\ epoch       = 0
    /\ record      = 0
    /\ contributed = [c \in Cranes |-> 0]
    /\ adminAdded  = 0
    /\ inflight    = [c \in Cranes |-> [amt |-> 0, ep |-> 0]]

Prepare(c) ==
    /\ inflight[c].amt = 0
    /\ record < MaxTotal
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![c] = [amt |-> 1, ep |-> epoch]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, record, contributed, adminAdded >>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ inflight[c].amt > 0
    /\ inflight[c].ep = epoch
    /\ record < MaxTotal
    /\ record'      = record + inflight[c].amt
    /\ contributed' = [contributed EXCEPT ![c] = @ + inflight[c].amt]
    /\ inflight'    = [inflight EXCEPT ![c] = [amt |-> 0, ep |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, adminAdded >>

Reject(c) ==
    /\ inflight[c].amt > 0
    /\ inflight[c].ep # epoch
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![c] = [amt |-> 0, ep |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, record, contributed, adminAdded >>

Cancel(c) ==
    /\ inflight[c].amt > 0
    /\ record = MaxTotal
    /\ inflight' = [inflight EXCEPT ![c] = [amt |-> 0, ep |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, record, contributed, adminAdded >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << record, contributed, adminAdded, inflight >>

AdminOverride ==
    /\ record < MaxTotal
    /\ record'     = record + 1
    /\ adminAdded' = adminAdded + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, contributed, inflight >>

RECURSIVE SumOver(_)
SumOver(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE
         IN contributed[x] + SumOver(S \ {x})

Halt ==
    /\ record = MaxTotal
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ \A c \in Cranes : inflight[c].amt = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Prepare(c) \/ Commit(c) \/ Reject(c) \/ Cancel(c)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ AdminOverride
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdates == record = SumOver(Cranes) + adminAdded
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    K = 2
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MaxTotal = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdates
nl:
A container-ship crane yard keeps a single shared tally of how many containers have been moved onto the vessel. Several cranes update this shared record concurrently using a read-prepare-commit discipline stamped with the yard's current configuration epoch. When the yard is reconfigured (a crane is added, removed, or re-slotted), the epoch is bumped, which invalidates any prepared-but-uncommitted update carrying the old epoch; such stale preparations are rejected and must be retried rather than blindly applied. A committed move both increases the shared tally and is recorded against the committing crane, so the tally always reflects exactly the sum of every crane's acknowledged contributions plus any moves the yard supervisor injects through an admin override. The admin override lets the supervisor add a move directly to the tally, and this too is accounted for. No acknowledged update may ever be dropped or double-counted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared tally always equals the sum of every crane's committed contributions plus the admin-injected moves, so no update is ever lost.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m9p4t2 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, Instances, MaxCap, MaxEpoch

ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxCap >= 1 /\ MaxEpoch \in Nat

VARIABLES epoch, cap, seated, reserve

vars == << epoch, cap, seated, reserve >>

NoRes == [ply |-> "none", ep |-> 0, active |-> FALSE]

Init ==
    /\ epoch   = 0
    /\ cap     = 1
    /\ seated  = {}
    /\ reserve = [i \in Instances |-> NoRes]

HeldBySomeone(p) == \E i \in Instances : reserve[i].active /\ reserve[i].ply = p

Reserve(i) ==
    /\ ~reserve[i].active
    /\ \E p \in Players :
        /\ p \notin seated
        /\ ~HeldBySomeone(p)
        /\ reserve' = [reserve EXCEPT ![i] = [ply |-> p, ep |-> epoch, active |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, cap, seated >>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ reserve[i].active
    /\ reserve[i].ep = epoch
    /\ reserve[i].ply \notin seated
    /\ Cardinality(seated) < cap
    /\ seated'  = seated \cup {reserve[i].ply}
    /\ reserve' = [reserve EXCEPT ![i] = NoRes]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, cap >>

DropStale(i) ==
    /\ reserve[i].active
    /\ reserve[i].ep # epoch
    /\ reserve' = [reserve EXCEPT ![i] = NoRes]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, cap, seated >>

Leave ==
    \E p \in seated :
        /\ seated' = seated \ {p}
        /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, cap, reserve >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ \E nc \in 1 .. MaxCap :
        /\ nc >= Cardinality(seated)
        /\ cap' = nc
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << seated, reserve >>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Reserve(i) \/ Commit(i) \/ DropStale(i)
    \/ Leave
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected == Cardinality(seated) <= cap
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Players = {p1, p2, p3}
    Instances = {i1, i2}
    MaxCap = 2
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby is filled by two independent matchmaker instances that both draw players from one shared queue into the same lobby pool. The lobby has a configured player capacity that the operators can retune at runtime; each retune is a reconfiguration that bumps a config epoch and may raise or lower the capacity, but never below the number of players already seated. A matchmaker seats a player in two steps: it reserves a candidate against the current epoch, then commits the seat only if the epoch is still current and a free slot remains. A reservation whose epoch has been superseded by a reconfiguration is stale and is discarded rather than seated. Players may also leave the lobby, freeing their slot. Because both matchmakers reserve from the same pool, they must jointly respect the live capacity. The seated player count must never exceed the configured capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of seated players never exceeds the currently configured lobby capacity.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m4p2t3 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Students, Courses, Cap, MaxQ

ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Cap >= 1 /\ MaxQ \in Nat /\ MaxQ >= 1

VARIABLES queue, current, freeSeats, enrolled

vars == << queue, current, freeSeats, enrolled >>

Idle == [st |-> "none", co |-> "none", active |-> FALSE]

Init ==
    /\ queue     = << >>
    /\ current   = Idle
    /\ freeSeats = [c \in Courses |-> Cap]
    /\ enrolled  = [c \in Courses |-> {}]

Queued(s, c) == \E i \in DOMAIN queue : queue[i].st = s /\ queue[i].co = c

SubmitReq ==
    /\ Len(queue) < MaxQ
    /\ \E s \in Students, c \in Courses :
        /\ s \notin enrolled[c]
        /\ ~Queued(s, c)
        /\ ~(current.active /\ current.st = s /\ current.co = c)
        /\ queue' = Append(queue, [st |-> s, co |-> c])
    /\ UNCHANGED << current, freeSeats, enrolled >>

StartProcess ==
    /\ ~current.active
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ current' = [st |-> Head(queue).st, co |-> Head(queue).co, active |-> TRUE]
    /\ queue'   = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED << freeSeats, enrolled >>

Enroll ==
    /\ current.active
    /\ freeSeats[current.co] > 0
    /\ current.st \notin enrolled[current.co]
    /\ freeSeats' = [freeSeats EXCEPT ![current.co] = @ - 1]
    /\ enrolled'  = [enrolled  EXCEPT ![current.co] = @ \cup {current.st}]
    /\ current'   = Idle
    /\ UNCHANGED queue

RejectReq ==
    /\ current.active
    /\ (freeSeats[current.co] = 0 \/ current.st \in enrolled[current.co])
    /\ current' = Idle
    /\ UNCHANGED << queue, freeSeats, enrolled >>

DropCourse ==
    \E c \in Courses :
      \E s \in enrolled[c] :
        /\ freeSeats' = [freeSeats EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
        /\ enrolled'  = [enrolled  EXCEPT ![c] = @ \ {s}]
        /\ UNCHANGED << queue, current >>

Next == SubmitReq \/ StartProcess \/ Enroll \/ RejectReq \/ DropCourse

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SeatConservation ==
    \A c \in Courses : freeSeats[c] + Cardinality(enrolled[c]) = Cap
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Students = {a, b}
    Courses = {cs, math}
    Cap = 1
    MaxQ = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SeatConservation
nl:
A university course-registration system accepts enrollment requests through a bounded work queue that applies backpressure: when the queue is full, no new request is admitted until the registrar's worker drains one. Each course starts with a fixed number of seats, and every seat is either free or held by exactly one enrolled student, so the seats of a course are conserved and none are ever conjured or lost. The worker is deliberately modeled as slow-but-reliable: it may take a queued request into processing after an arbitrary delay, but it never crashes and never drops a request. When it processes a request it either enrolls the student, consuming one free seat, or rejects the request when the course is already full. A student may later drop the course, which returns their seat to the free pool. Across all of this the seat bookkeeping of each course must stay balanced.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every course, the number of free seats plus the number of enrolled students always equals that course's fixed seat capacity.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m0p5t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Aircraft, Runways, MaxVer

ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat

VARIABLES ver, occupant, req, cleared, clearLog

vars == << ver, occupant, req, cleared, clearLog >>

NoAC  == "nobody"
NoRw  == "norwy"
IdleReq == [rwy |-> NoRw, rv |-> 0, active |-> FALSE]

Init ==
    /\ ver      = [r \in Runways |-> 0]
    /\ occupant = [r \in Runways |-> NoAC]
    /\ req      = [a \in Aircraft |-> IdleReq]
    /\ cleared  = {}
    /\ clearLog = << >>

Acquire(a) ==
    /\ a \notin cleared
    /\ ~req[a].active
    /\ \E r \in Runways :
        req' = [req EXCEPT ![a] = [rwy |-> r, rv |-> ver[r], active |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, occupant, cleared, clearLog >>

CommitLock(a) ==
    LET r == req[a].rwy IN
    /\ req[a].active
    /\ a \notin cleared
    /\ req[a].rv = ver[r]
    /\ occupant[r] = NoAC
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = a]
    /\ ver'      = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
    /\ req'      = [req EXCEPT ![a] = IdleReq]
    /\ UNCHANGED << cleared, clearLog >>

RetryLock(a) ==
    LET r == req[a].rwy IN
    /\ req[a].active
    /\ req[a].rv # ver[r]
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![a] = [rwy |-> r, rv |-> ver[r], active |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, occupant, cleared, clearLog >>

IssueClearance(a) ==
    \E r \in Runways :
        /\ occupant[r] = a
        /\ a \notin cleared
        /\ cleared'  = cleared \cup {a}
        /\ clearLog' = Append(clearLog, a)
        /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = NoAC]
        /\ ver'      = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED req

AdminOverride ==
    \E a \in Aircraft :
        /\ a \notin cleared
        /\ cleared'  = cleared \cup {a}
        /\ clearLog' = Append(clearLog, a)
        /\ UNCHANGED << ver, occupant, req >>

AbortReq(a) ==
    /\ req[a].active
    /\ a \in cleared
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![a] = IdleReq]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, occupant, cleared, clearLog >>

ReleaseCleared ==
    \E r \in Runways :
        /\ occupant[r] # NoAC
        /\ occupant[r] \in cleared
        /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = NoAC]
        /\ ver'      = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED << req, cleared, clearLog >>

Reconfigure ==
    \E r \in Runways :
        /\ ver[r] < MaxVer
        /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED << occupant, req, cleared, clearLog >>

Halt ==
    /\ cleared = Aircraft
    /\ \A a \in Aircraft : ~req[a].active
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Acquire(a) \/ CommitLock(a) \/ RetryLock(a)
                            \/ IssueClearance(a) \/ AbortReq(a)
    \/ AdminOverride
    \/ ReleaseCleared
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ClearanceUnique ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN clearLog : (i # j) => (clearLog[i] # clearLog[j])
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Aircraft = {ac1, ac2}
    Runways = {rw1, rw2}
    MaxVer = 6
INIT Init

An air-traffic runway allocator hands departing aircraft exclusive use of a runway before issuing a takeoff clearance. Because several ground controllers may try to grab the same runway, each acquisition uses optimistic locking: a controller reads the runway's configuration version, and its lock commits only if the version is still what it read, otherwise it re-reads and retries. Committing a lock bumps the runway version, which is how competing controllers detect that they lost the race and must retry. Weather reconfigurations independently bump runway versions as well. ------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m0p5t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Aircraft, Runways, MaxVer

ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat

VARIABLES ver, occupant, req, cleared, clearLog

vars == << ver, occupant, req, cleared, clearLog >>

NoAC  == "nobody"
NoRw  == "norwy"
IdleReq == [rwy |-> NoRw, rv |-> 0, active |-> FALSE]

Init ==
    /\ ver      = [r \in Runways |-> 0]
    /\ occupant = [r \in Runways |-> NoAC]
    /\ req      = [a \in Aircraft |-> IdleReq]
    /\ cleared  = {}
    /\ clearLog = << >>

Acquire(a) ==
    /\ a \notin cleared
    /\ ~req[a].active
    /\ \E r \in Runways :
        req' = [req EXCEPT ![a] = [rwy |-> r, rv |-> ver[r], active |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, occupant, cleared, clearLog >>

CommitLock(a) ==
    LET r == req[a].rwy IN
    /\ req[a].active
    /\ a \notin cleared
    /\ req[a].rv = ver[r]
    /\ occupant[r] = NoAC
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = a]
    /\ ver'      = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
    /\ req'      = [req EXCEPT ![a] = IdleReq]
    /\ UNCHANGED << cleared, clearLog >>

RetryLock(a) ==
    LET r == req[a].rwy IN
    /\ req[a].active
    /\ req[a].rv # ver[r]
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![a] = [rwy |-> r, rv |-> ver[r], active |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, occupant, cleared, clearLog >>

IssueClearance(a) ==
    \E r \in Runways :
        /\ occupant[r] = a
        /\ a \notin cleared
        /\ cleared'  = cleared \cup {a}
        /\ clearLog' = Append(clearLog, a)
        /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = NoAC]
        /\ ver'      = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED req

AdminOverride ==
    \E a \in Aircraft :
        /\ a \notin cleared
        /\ cleared'  = cleared \cup {a}
        /\ clearLog' = Append(clearLog, a)
        /\ UNCHANGED << ver, occupant, req >>

AbortReq(a) ==
    /\ req[a].active
    /\ a \in cleared
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![a] = IdleReq]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, occupant, cleared, clearLog >>

ReleaseCleared ==
    \E r \in Runways :
        /\ occupant[r] # NoAC
        /\ occupant[r] \in cleared
        /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = NoAC]
        /\ ver'      = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED << req, cleared, clearLog >>

Reconfigure ==
    \E r \in Runways :
        /\ ver[r] < MaxVer
        /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED << occupant, req, cleared, clearLog >>

Halt ==
    /\ cleared = Aircraft
    /\ \A a \in Aircraft : ~req[a].active
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Acquire(a) \/ CommitLock(a) \/ RetryLock(a)
                            \/ IssueClearance(a) \/ AbortReq(a)
    \/ AdminOverride
    \/ ReleaseCleared
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

ClearanceUnique ==
    \A i, j \in DOMAIN clearLog : (i # j) => (clearLog[i] # clearLog[j])
=============================================================================

------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m3p0t1 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Machines, MaxTerm

ASSUME MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxTerm >= 1

VARIABLES term, role, votedFor, votes, alive

vars == << term, role, votedFor, votes, alive >>

NoVote == "none"
Quorum == Cardinality(Machines) \div 2 + 1

Init ==
    /\ term     = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ role     = [m \in Machines |-> "follower"]
    /\ votedFor = [m \in Machines |-> NoVote]
    /\ votes    = [m \in Machines |-> {}]
    /\ alive    = [m \in Machines |-> TRUE]

StartElection(c) ==
    /\ alive[c]
    /\ term[c] < MaxTerm
    /\ term'     = [term EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ role'     = [role EXCEPT ![c] = "candidate"]
    /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![c] = c]
    /\ votes'    = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED alive

CastVote(v, c) ==
    /\ alive[v]
    /\ role[c] = "candidate"
    /\ term[c] >= term[v]
    /\ (term[c] > term[v] \/ votedFor[v] = NoVote)
    /\ v \notin votes[c]
    /\ term'     = [term EXCEPT ![v] = term[c]]
    /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![v] = c]
    /\ role'     = [role EXCEPT ![v] = IF v = c THEN role[v] ELSE "follower"]
    /\ votes'    = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = @ \cup {v}]
    /\ UNCHANGED alive

BecomeLeader(c) ==
    /\ role[c] = "candidate"
    /\ Cardinality(votes[c]) >= Quorum
    /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![c] = "leader"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << term, votedFor, votes, alive >>

Crash(m) ==
    /\ alive[m]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ role'  = [role EXCEPT ![m] = "follower"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << term, votedFor, votes >>

Recover(m) ==
    /\ ~alive[m]
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << term, role, votedFor, votes >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Machines : StartElection(c) \/ BecomeLeader(c)
    \/ \E v \in Machines, c \in Machines : CastVote(v, c)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Crash(m) \/ Recover(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OneLeaderPerTerm ==
    \A a, b \in Machines :
        (role[a] = "leader" /\ role[b] = "leader" /\ term[a] = term[b]) => a = b
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Machines = {m1, m2, m3}
    MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OneLeaderPerTerm
nl:
A network of vending machines elects one leader to coordinate restocking; leadership is the critical resource, and two machines must never both act as leader in the same election term. Elections proceed in terms: a machine can start a new election by advancing to a higher term and soliciting votes. Each machine casts at most one vote per term, and vote messages travel over an unreliable bus that may deliver them in any order, so votes are recorded in arbitrary sequence. A candidate becomes leader only after collecting votes from a strict majority of the machines in its term. Any machine may crash, which drops it back to a plain follower and triggers a failover election, and a crashed machine may later recover as a follower. Because each machine votes only once per term and leadership needs a majority, at most one machine can win any given term.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two distinct machines are simultaneously leader in the same election term.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m5p3t2 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Jobs, Printers, Replicas

NoJob == "none"
Quorum == Cardinality(Replicas) \div 2 + 1

VARIABLES assigned, held, rvote, proposals

vars == << assigned, held, rvote, proposals >>

Init ==
    /\ assigned  = [j \in Jobs |-> NoJob]
    /\ held      = [p \in Printers |-> NoJob]
    /\ rvote     = [r \in Replicas |-> [p \in Printers |-> NoJob]]
    /\ proposals = {}

Propose ==
    \E j \in Jobs, p \in Printers :
        /\ assigned[j] = NoJob
        /\ held[p] = NoJob
        /\ [job |-> j, prn |-> p] \notin proposals
        /\ proposals' = proposals \cup {[job |-> j, prn |-> p]}
        /\ UNCHANGED << assigned, held, rvote >>

Vote ==
    \E r \in Replicas, pr \in proposals :
        /\ rvote[r][pr.prn] = NoJob
        /\ rvote' = [rvote EXCEPT ![r][pr.prn] = pr.job]
        /\ UNCHANGED << assigned, held, proposals >>

Backers(j, p) == { r \in Replicas : rvote[r][p] = j }

Commit ==
    \E pr \in proposals :
        /\ assigned[pr.job] = NoJob
        /\ Cardinality(Backers(pr.job, pr.prn)) >= Quorum
        /\ assigned'  = [assigned EXCEPT ![pr.job] = pr.prn]
        /\ held'      = [held EXCEPT ![pr.prn] = pr.job]
        /\ proposals' = proposals \ {pr}
        /\ UNCHANGED rvote

Withdraw ==
    \E pr \in proposals :
        /\ (assigned[pr.job] # NoJob \/ held[pr.prn] # NoJob)
        /\ proposals' = proposals \ {pr}
        /\ UNCHANGED << assigned, held, rvote >>

Release ==
    \E j \in Jobs :
        /\ assigned[j] # NoJob
        /\ LET p == assigned[j] IN
            /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![j] = NoJob]
            /\ held'     = [held EXCEPT ![p] = NoJob]
            /\ rvote'    = [r \in Replicas |-> [rvote[r] EXCEPT ![p] = NoJob]]
        /\ UNCHANGED proposals

Next == Propose \/ Vote \/ Commit \/ Withdraw \/ Release

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAllocation ==
    \A a, b \in Jobs :
        (assigned[a] # NoJob /\ assigned[a] = assigned[b]) => a = b
=============================================================================
nl:
A print shop runs two independent job spoolers that both draw from one shared pool of printers. To allocate a printer to a print job, a spooler opens a proposal binding that job to that printer, and a set of replica arbiters vote on it. Each replica may cast at most one vote per printer, choosing which single job it backs for that printer. A proposal is committed, actually allocating the printer to the job, only once it has collected votes from a strict majority of the replicas. Because every replica backs only one job per printer, two competing jobs can never both reach a majority for the same printer, so no printer is ever double-allocated. A job whose proposal is overtaken can withdraw, and an allocated printer can later be released back to the pool, clearing its votes. Two spoolers sharing the pool may propose the same printer for different jobs concurrently, and the quorum is what arbitrates.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No printer is ever allocated to two different jobs at the same time.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m7p6t4 -------------------------

CONSTANTS Robots, Zones, MaxGen

ASSUME MaxGen \in Nat

NoOne == "empty"

VARIABLES reg, working, gen, commissioned

vars == << reg, working, gen, commissioned >>

Init ==
    /\ reg          = [z \in Zones |-> [owner |-> NoOne, g |-> 0]]
    /\ working      = [z \in Zones |-> NoOne]
    /\ gen          = 0
    /\ commissioned = Zones

Acquire(rob, z) ==
    /\ z \in commissioned
    /\ reg[z].owner = NoOne
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![z] = [owner |-> rob, g |-> gen]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << working, gen, commissioned >>

StartWork(rob, z) ==
    /\ reg[z].owner = rob
    /\ reg[z].g = gen
    /\ working[z] = NoOne
    /\ working' = [working EXCEPT ![z] = rob]
    /\ UNCHANGED << reg, gen, commissioned >>

FinishWork(z) ==
    /\ working[z] # NoOne
    /\ working' = [working EXCEPT ![z] = NoOne]
    /\ UNCHANGED << reg, gen, commissioned >>

ReleaseZone(z) ==
    /\ reg[z].owner # NoOne
    /\ working[z] = NoOne
    /\ reg' = [reg EXCEPT ![z] = [owner |-> NoOne, g |-> gen]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << working, gen, commissioned >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ gen < MaxGen
    /\ \E S \in SUBSET Zones :
        /\ S # {}
        /\ commissioned' = S
    /\ gen'     = gen + 1
    /\ reg'     = [z \in Zones |-> [owner |-> NoOne, g |-> gen + 1]]
    /\ working' = [z \in Zones |-> NoOne]

Next ==
    \/ \E rob \in Robots, z \in Zones : Acquire(rob, z) \/ StartWork(rob, z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : FinishWork(z) \/ ReleaseZone(z)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

OnlyAuthorizedWork ==
    \A z \in Zones :
        working[z] # NoOne =>
            (reg[z].owner = working[z] /\ reg[z].g = gen)

CONSTANTS
    Robots = {rb1, rb2}
    Zones = {z1, z2}
    MaxGen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyAuthorizedWork
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet operates in commissioned floor zones, and a robot may perform work in a zone only while it holds a current authorization for that zone. Authorization is a compare-and-swap register per zone: a robot claims an unowned zone by swapping the register's owner from empty to itself, stamping it with the fleet's current generation number. The fleet controller can change capacity at runtime, commissioning or decommissioning zones; every such reconfiguration bumps the generation number and revokes all outstanding authorizations, clearing owners and stopping any work in progress. This makes any authorization from an earlier generation stale. A robot is permitted to start work in a zone only when it is the registered owner and its authorization matches the live generation, so neither an unauthorized robot nor one holding a stale, superseded grant may act. Robots finish work and release zones back to the pool.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any zone with work in progress is owned by exactly the robot doing the work, under the current generation, so no unauthorized or stale robot ever acts.

CONSTANTS Feeders, Slots, MaxEpoch

ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat

None == "none"
IdleReq == [slot |-> None, ep |-> 0, active |-> FALSE]

VARIABLES epoch, grantset, pending, drawing

vars == << epoch, grantset, pending, drawing >>

Init ==
    /\ epoch    = 0
    /\ grantset = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ pending  = [f \in Feeders |-> IdleReq]
    /\ drawing  = [s \in Slots |-> None]

Request(f) ==
    /\ ~pending[f].active
    /\ \E s \in Slots :
        pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![f] = [slot |-> s, ep |-> epoch, active |-> TRUE]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, grantset, drawing >>

Grant(f) ==
    LET s == pending[f].slot IN
    /\ pending[f].active
    /\ pending[f].ep = epoch
    /\ grantset[s] = {}
    /\ grantset' = [grantset EXCEPT ![s] = {f}]
    /\ pending'  = [pending EXCEPT ![f] = IdleReq]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, drawing >>

RejectStale(f) ==
    /\ pending[f].active
    /\ pending[f].ep # epoch
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![f] = IdleReq]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, grantset, drawing >>

StartDraw(s) ==
    \E f \in grantset[s] :
        /\ drawing[s] = None
        /\ drawing' = [drawing EXCEPT ![s] = f]
        /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, grantset, pending >>

StopDraw(s) ==
    /\ drawing[s] # None
    /\ drawing'  = [drawing EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ grantset' = [grantset EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, pending >>

ReleaseGrant(s) ==
    /\ grantset[s] # {}
    /\ drawing[s] = None
    /\ grantset' = [grantset EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, pending, drawing >>

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch'    = epoch + 1
    /\ grantset' = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ drawing'  = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ UNCHANGED pending

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Request(f) \/ Grant(f) \/ RejectStale(f)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : StartDraw(s) \/ StopDraw(s) \/ ReleaseGrant(s)
    \/ Reconfigure

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleGrant ==
    \A s \in Slots : \A a, b \in grantset[s] : a = b
=============================================================================

    Feeders = {f1, f2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
A power-grid load shedder allocates spinning-reserve slots to feeders that need backup power. Allocation runs under an epoch-numbered configuration: a feeder requests a slot stamping its request with the current epoch, and the request is honored only if its epoch is still live and the slot is currently free, so a single slot is never handed to two feeders at once. When the grid is reconfigured, the epoch is advanced, all outstanding reserve grants are revoked, and any request carrying a superseded epoch is rejected and must be retried. A feeder that has been granted a slot may begin drawing reserve power; feeders are modeled as slow-but-reliable, so a feeder may hold and draw on a slot for an arbitrary time but never crashes, and it always eventually stops drawing and releases the slot. A granted slot that has not yet started drawing can also simply be released back to the free pool. Two feeders must never both hold the same reserve slot.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m1p5t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Cranes, Containers

Lost == "lost"

VARIABLES holder, sealed, sealLog, crashed

vars == << holder, sealed, sealLog, crashed >>

Init ==
    /\ holder  = CHOOSE c \in Cranes : TRUE
    /\ sealed  = [ct \in Containers |-> FALSE]
    /\ sealLog = << >>
    /\ crashed = {}

Alive == Cranes \ crashed

SealContainer ==
    /\ holder \in Alive
    /\ \E ct \in Containers :
        /\ ~sealed[ct]
        /\ sealed'  = [sealed EXCEPT ![ct] = TRUE]
        /\ sealLog' = Append(sealLog, ct)
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, crashed >>

PassToken ==
    /\ holder \in Alive
    /\ \E c \in Alive :
        /\ c # holder
        /\ holder' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED << sealed, sealLog, crashed >>

CrashCrane ==
    \E c \in Alive :
        /\ Cardinality(crashed) < Cardinality(Cranes) - 1
        /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
        /\ holder'  = IF holder = c THEN Lost ELSE holder
        /\ UNCHANGED << sealed, sealLog >>

RegenerateToken ==
    /\ holder = Lost
    /\ \E c \in Alive : holder' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED << sealed, sealLog, crashed >>

AllSealed == \A ct \in Containers : sealed[ct]

Halt == AllSealed /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == SealContainer \/ PassToken \/ CrashCrane \/ RegenerateToken \/ Halt

In a container-ship crane yard, several cranes coordinate by circulating a single access token around a ring; only the crane currently holding the token is allowed to act. The token holder may permanently weld-seal a container onto the vessel, which is a one-time irreversible operation that must never be performed twice on the same container. Each seal is appended to a permanent seal log. The token is passed onward to another live crane so access keeps rotating. Any crane may crash silently at any moment: it simply stops participating, and if it was holding the token the token is lost. When the token is lost, the remaining live cranes regenerate a fresh token and hand it to one of them, so work can continue. At least one crane always stays alive to keep the ring recoverable. No matter how the token moves, crashes, or is regenerated, no container is ever sealed more than once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No container appears more than once in the seal log, so the irreversible weld-seal happens at most once per container.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m3p4t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, Blocks, Trains, Cap, MaxTerm

ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Cap >= 1 /\ MaxTerm \in Nat

NoLeader == "none"
Outside  == "out"

VARIABLES leader, trainLoc, term, crashed

vars == << leader, trainLoc, term, crashed >>

Init ==
    /\ leader   = NoLeader
    /\ trainLoc = [t \in Trains |-> Outside]
    /\ term     = 0
    /\ crashed  = {}

Occ(b) == Cardinality({ t \in Trains : trainLoc[t] = b })

ElectLeader(c) ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = c
    /\ term'   = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << trainLoc, crashed >>

LeaderCrash ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {leader}
    /\ leader'  = NoLeader
    /\ UNCHANGED << trainLoc, term >>

GrantEntry(t, b) ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ trainLoc[t] = Outside
    /\ Occ(b) < Cap
    /\ trainLoc' = [trainLoc EXCEPT ![t] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, crashed >>

ExitBlock(t) ==
    /\ trainLoc[t] # Outside
    /\ trainLoc' = [trainLoc EXCEPT ![t] = Outside]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, crashed >>

AdminForce(t, b) ==
    /\ trainLoc[t] = Outside
    /\ Occ(b) < Cap
    /\ trainLoc' = [trainLoc EXCEPT ![t] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leader, term, crashed >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : ElectLeader(c)
    \/ LeaderCrash
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : GrantEntry(t, b) \/ AdminForce(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains : ExitBlock(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

nl:
A subway signalling system divides a line into track blocks, and each block can safely hold at most a fixed number of trains at once. A set of signalling controllers elects one leader to grant block entries; only a live leader may admit a train into a block, and it does so only when the block still has spare capacity. Leadership can fail over: the current leader may crash, after which it is removed from service and the remaining controllers elect a new leader in a higher term. While there is no leader, ordinary grants pause, but trains already in blocks may still exit. A dispatcher holds an admin override that can force a train into a block directly, bypassing the leader, but even the override refuses to push a block past its capacity. Trains leave blocks as they progress down the line. Under every combination of election, failover, and override, no block ever holds more trains than its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No track block ever contains more trains than its fixed capacity.

        /\ d \notin opened
        /\ lockedBy' = [lockedBy EXCEPT ![d] = c]
        /\ target'   = [target EXCEPT ![c] = d]
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "preparing"]
    /\ vote'   = [vote EXCEPT ![c] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << opened, openLog >>

VoteYes(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "preparing"
    /\ vote[c] = "none"
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![c] = "yes"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << cstate, target, lockedBy, opened, openLog >>

    /\ cstate[c] = "preparing"
    /\ vote[c] = "none"
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![c] = "no"]

    /\ target[c] \notin opened

    /\ vote[c] = "no"
    /\ lockedBy' = [lockedBy EXCEPT ![target[c]] = None]
    /\ cstate'   = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << target, vote, opened, openLog >>

    /\ lockedBy' = IF target[c] # None /\ lockedBy[target[c]] = c

                   ELSE lockedBy
    /\ target'   = [target EXCEPT ![c] = None]
    /\ vote'     = [vote EXCEPT ![c] = "none"]
    /\ cstate'   = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED << opened, openLog >>

    /\ opened = Doors
    /\ \A c \in Coords : cstate[c] = "idle"

A smart-home door-lock network issues one-time entry grants, each tied to a specific door, and burning a grant to physically open that door is an irreversible act that must happen at most once per door. Two independent controller instances share the same pool of doors and coordinate each open through two-phase commit. A controller begins a transaction by locking a free door (the prepare phase claims it exclusively), the door participant then votes yes or no, and only on a yes vote does the controller commit, which opens the door and permanently consumes its one-time grant. A no vote aborts the transaction and releases the door lock without opening it. After committing or aborting, the controller resets to idle and releases its hold on the door. Because both instances draw from the same door pool, prepare-locking and the consume-once check together ensure a door is never opened twice, even after its lock is released.

Each settlement batch has an id and a fixed set of enrolled participant banks; only a bank enrolled in the current batch may have its settlement leg committed.     /\ vote = "none"
    /\ vote' = "yes"

VoteNo ==

    /\ vote = "none"
    /\ vote' = "no"

    /\ vote = "yes"
    /\ blockCount' = [blockCount EXCEPT ![mstate.dst] = @ + 1]

    /\ mstate'     = IdleMove

    /\ vote = "no"

    /\ \E src \in Blocks, dst \in Blocks :

        /\ leader'  = IF leader = e THEN NoLeader ELSE leader

Any matching engine may crash silently at any point; if the crashed engine was the leader, leadership is vacated and the surviving engines fail over by electing a new leader in a higher term. ------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m5p3t3 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Patrons, Copies, Nodes

None == "none"
Majority == Cardinality(Nodes) \div 2 + 1

VARIABLES holds, backing, proposals

vars == << holds, backing, proposals >>

Init ==
    /\ holds     = [p \in Patrons |-> {}]
    /\ backing   = [n \in Nodes |-> [c \in Copies |-> None]]
    /\ proposals = {}

HeldBy(c) == { p \in Patrons : c \in holds[p] }

Request ==
    \E p \in Patrons, c \in Copies :
        /\ HeldBy(c) = {}
        /\ [pat |-> p, cop |-> c] \notin proposals
        /\ proposals' = proposals \cup {[pat |-> p, cop |-> c]}
        /\ UNCHANGED << holds, backing >>

CastVote ==
    \E n \in Nodes, pr \in proposals :
        /\ backing[n][pr.cop] = None
        /\ backing' = [backing EXCEPT ![n][pr.cop] = pr.pat]
        /\ UNCHANGED << holds, proposals >>

Backers(p, c) == { n \in Nodes : backing[n][c] = p }

Grant ==
    \E pr \in proposals :
        /\ HeldBy(pr.cop) = {}
        /\ Cardinality(Backers(pr.pat, pr.cop)) >= Majority
        /\ holds'     = [holds EXCEPT ![pr.pat] = @ \cup {pr.cop}]
        /\ proposals' = proposals \ {pr}
        /\ UNCHANGED backing

Withdraw ==
    \E pr \in proposals :
        /\ HeldBy(pr.cop) # {}
        /\ proposals' = proposals \ {pr}
        /\ UNCHANGED << holds, backing >>

Return ==
    \E p \in Patrons :
      \E c \in holds[p] :
        /\ holds'   = [holds EXCEPT ![p] = @ \ {c}]
        /\ backing' = [n \in Nodes |-> [backing[n] EXCEPT ![c] = None]]
        /\ UNCHANGED proposals

Next == Request \/ CastVote \/ Grant \/ Withdraw \/ Return

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleReservation ==
    \A c \in Copies : \A a, b \in Patrons :
        (c \in holds[a] /\ c \in holds[b]) => a = b

nl:
A library book reservation system manages individual physical copies of titles, and each copy may be reserved by at most one patron at a time. Reservations are agreed by a set of replicated catalog nodes that vote: when a patron requests a copy, the catalog nodes each cast at most one vote per copy, choosing which single patron they back for that copy. A patron's reservation is granted only once a strict majority of the nodes have backed that patron for that copy, and only if the copy is not already held. Because each node backs only one patron per copy, two patrons can never both win a majority for the same copy. The catalog nodes are modeled as slow-but-reliable: a node may lag arbitrarily before casting its vote, but it never fails and its vote is eventually counted. A patron can return a held copy, which clears the copy's votes so it can be reserved afresh, and a request for an already-held copy can be withdrawn.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No physical copy is ever held by two different patrons at the same time.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m8p1t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Drones, Regions, CellSlots, MaxObs

ASSUME MaxObs \in Nat

None == "none"
Cells == Regions \X CellSlots
RegionOf(cell) == cell[1]

VARIABLES mapCount, contributed, regionLock, cellLock, crashed

vars == << mapCount, contributed, regionLock, cellLock, crashed >>

Init ==
    /\ mapCount    = [c \in Cells |-> 0]
    /\ contributed = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ regionLock  = [r \in Regions |-> None]
    /\ cellLock    = [c \in Cells |-> None]
    /\ crashed     = {}

Live == Drones \ crashed

LockRegion(d, r) ==
    /\ d \in Live
    /\ regionLock[r] = None
    /\ regionLock' = [regionLock EXCEPT ![r] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED << mapCount, contributed, cellLock, crashed >>

LockCell(d, cell) ==
    /\ d \in Live
    /\ regionLock[RegionOf(cell)] = d
    /\ cellLock[cell] = None
    /\ cellLock' = [cellLock EXCEPT ![cell] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED << mapCount, contributed, regionLock, crashed >>

Record(d, cell) ==
    /\ d \in Live
    /\ cellLock[cell] = d
    /\ mapCount[cell] < MaxObs
    /\ mapCount'    = [mapCount EXCEPT ![cell] = @ + 1]
    /\ contributed' = [contributed EXCEPT ![d] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << regionLock, cellLock, crashed >>

UnlockCell(d, cell) ==
    /\ cellLock[cell] = d
    /\ cellLock' = [cellLock EXCEPT ![cell] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << mapCount, contributed, regionLock, crashed >>

UnlockRegion(d, r) ==
    /\ regionLock[r] = d
    /\ \A cell \in Cells : (RegionOf(cell) = r) => cellLock[cell] # d
    /\ regionLock' = [regionLock EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << mapCount, contributed, cellLock, crashed >>

Crash(d) ==
    /\ d \in Live
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED << mapCount, contributed, regionLock, cellLock >>

ReclaimLocks(d) ==
    /\ d \in crashed
    /\ ( (\E r \in Regions : regionLock[r] = d) \/ (\E cell \in Cells : cellLock[cell] = d) )
    /\ regionLock' = [r \in Regions |-> IF regionLock[r] = d THEN None ELSE regionLock[r]]
    /\ cellLock'   = [cell \in Cells |-> IF cellLock[cell] = d THEN None ELSE cellLock[cell]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << mapCount, contributed, crashed >>

Recover(d) ==
    /\ d \in crashed
    /\ \A r \in Regions : regionLock[r] # d
    /\ \A cell \in Cells : cellLock[cell] # d
    /\ crashed' = crashed \ {d}
    /\ UNCHANGED << mapCount, contributed, regionLock, cellLock >>

AllFull == \A cell \in Cells : mapCount[cell] = MaxObs

Halt == AllFull /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones, r \in Regions : LockRegion(d, r) \/ UnlockRegion(d, r)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, cell \in Cells : LockCell(d, cell) \/ Record(d, cell) \/ UnlockCell(d, cell)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Crash(d) \/ ReclaimLocks(d) \/ Recover(d)
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RECURSIVE SumCells(_)
SumCells(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE IN mapCount[x] + SumCells(S \ {x})

RECURSIVE SumContrib(_)
SumContrib(D) ==
    IF D = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in D : TRUE IN contributed[x] + SumContrib(D \ {x})

NoLostObservations == SumCells(Cells) = SumContrib(Drones)
=============================================================================
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm maintains a shared observation map, where each map cell counts confirmed fire sightings. Drones record sightings concurrently, and every recorded sighting must be reflected exactly once in the map: the global observation total must always equal the sum of what every drone has committed, so no update is ever lost or double-counted. To record into a cell a drone takes locks hierarchically: first the coarse lock on the cell's region, and only then the fine lock on the individual cell. Holding both, the drone commits a sighting, which increments that cell's count and its own contribution counter together. A drone may crash silently at any time, keeping its locks stuck; a recovery step reclaims the locks a crashed drone was holding so the swarm can continue, and a crashed drone whose locks have been reclaimed may rejoin the swarm, but the sightings the drone already committed remain counted. Drones release the cell lock and then the region lock when finished.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total of all map-cell sighting counts always equals the sum of every drone's committed contributions, so no update is lost.

        /\ secReqs'    = secReqs \ {req}
        /\ UNCHANGED << uplinkLock, transmitting, upReqs >>

GrantUplink ==
    \E d \in upReqs :
        /\ \E s \in Sectors : sectorLock[s] = d
        /\ uplinkLock = None
        /\ uplinkLock' = d
        /\ upReqs'     = upReqs \ {d}
        /\ UNCHANGED << sectorLock, transmitting, secReqs >>

StartTransmit ==
    \E d \in Drones :
        /\ uplinkLock = d
        /\ d \notin transmitting
        /\ transmitting' = transmitting \cup {d}
        /\ UNCHANGED << sectorLock, uplinkLock, secReqs, upReqs >>

StopTransmit ==
    \E d \in transmitting :
        /\ transmitting' = transmitting \ {d}
        /\ uplinkLock'   = None
        /\ UNCHANGED << sectorLock, secReqs, upReqs >>

ReleaseSector ==
    \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors :
        /\ sectorLock[s] = d
        /\ uplinkLock # d
        /\ d \notin transmitting
        /\ sectorLock' = [sectorLock EXCEPT ![s] = None]
        /\ UNCHANGED << uplinkLock, transmitting, secReqs, upReqs >>

Next ==
    \/ SubmitSectorReq \/ SubmitUplinkReq
    \/ GrantSector \/ GrantUplink
    \/ StartTransmit \/ StopTransmit \/ ReleaseSector

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

UplinkExclusive == \A a, b \in transmitting : a = b
=============================================================================
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares a single satellite uplink that only one drone may transmit on at a time; the uplink is the critical resource and must be held mutually exclusively. Access is protected by hierarchical locks: a drone first acquires the coarse lock on its operating sector, and only while holding a sector lock may it be granted the fine lock on the shared uplink. Lock requests are sent over a lossy radio mesh that delivers them out of order, so the arbiter grants pending sector and uplink requests in arbitrary sequence rather than in the order they were made. A drone that holds the uplink lock may begin transmitting, and it stops transmitting and releases the uplink when done, after which another waiting drone can be granted it. Sector locks are released once a drone no longer needs the uplink. No matter how requests are reordered, the uplink is never used by two drones at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one drone is transmitting on the shared uplink at any time.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m4p4t5 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Fridges, Cap, MaxQ

ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Cap >= 1 /\ MaxQ \in Nat /\ MaxQ >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES queue, screening, stored, quarantine

vars == << queue, screening, stored, quarantine >>

Init ==
    /\ queue      = << >>
    /\ screening  = None
    /\ stored     = [f \in Fridges |-> 0]
    /\ quarantine = [f \in Fridges |-> 0]

Occupancy(f) == stored[f] + quarantine[f]

Arrive ==
    /\ Len(queue) < MaxQ
    /\ \E f \in Fridges : queue' = Append(queue, f)
    /\ UNCHANGED << screening, stored, quarantine >>

StartScreen ==
    /\ screening = None
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ screening' = Head(queue)
    /\ queue'     = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED << stored, quarantine >>

StorePass ==
    /\ screening # None
    /\ Occupancy(screening) < Cap
    /\ stored'    = [stored EXCEPT ![screening] = @ + 1]
    /\ screening' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << queue, quarantine >>

Divert ==
    /\ screening # None
    /\ Occupancy(screening) < Cap
    /\ quarantine' = [quarantine EXCEPT ![screening] = @ + 1]
    /\ screening'  = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << queue, stored >>

RejectFull ==
    /\ screening # None
    /\ Occupancy(screening) = Cap
    /\ screening' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << queue, stored, quarantine >>

Dispense ==
    \E f \in Fridges :
        /\ stored[f] > 0
        /\ stored' = [stored EXCEPT ![f] = @ - 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED << queue, screening, quarantine >>

DiscardQuarantine ==
    \E f \in Fridges :
        /\ quarantine[f] > 0
        /\ quarantine' = [quarantine EXCEPT ![f] = @ - 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED << queue, screening, stored >>

AdminInject ==
    \E f \in Fridges :
        /\ Occupancy(f) < Cap
        /\ stored' = [stored EXCEPT ![f] = @ + 1]
        /\ UNCHANGED << queue, screening, quarantine >>

Next ==
    \/ Arrive \/ StartScreen \/ StorePass \/ Divert \/ RejectFull
    \/ Dispense \/ DiscardQuarantine \/ AdminInject

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

WithinCapacity == \A f \in Fridges : Occupancy(f) <= Cap
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Fridges = {f1, f2}
    Cap = 2
    MaxQ = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A blood-bank intake system feeds incoming donations through a bounded work queue that applies backpressure: when the queue is full, no further donation is admitted until an item is screened out of it. Each donation is destined for a specific fridge, and every fridge has a fixed capacity shared between good units in storage and units held in quarantine, so the combined occupancy of a fridge must never exceed its capacity. A screener takes the next queued donation and either passes it into storage or diverts it to quarantine, in each case only if the target fridge still has room; if the fridge is full the donation is rejected and discarded. Stored units are dispensed for use and quarantined units are eventually discarded, both freeing capacity. A supervisor's admin override can inject a unit straight into a fridge's storage, bypassing the queue, but it too refuses to push a fridge past its capacity. Under all of this, no fridge is ever filled beyond its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every fridge, the number of stored units plus quarantined units never exceeds that fridge's capacity.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od14m6p2t3 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Drones, Total, LeaseLen, MaxT

ASSUME Total \in Nat /\ LeaseLen \in Nat /\ LeaseLen >= 1 /\ MaxT \in Nat

VARIABLES clock, pool, held, leaseExp

vars == << clock, pool, held, leaseExp >>

Init ==
    /\ clock    = 0
    /\ pool     = Total
    /\ held     = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ leaseExp = [d \in Drones |-> 0]

AcquireLease(d) ==
    /\ pool > 0
    /\ pool'     = pool - 1
    /\ held'     = [held EXCEPT ![d] = @ + 1]
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![d] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

RenewLease(d) ==
    /\ held[d] > 0
    /\ leaseExp[d] > clock
    /\ leaseExp' = [leaseExp EXCEPT ![d] = clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, pool, held >>

ReleaseLease(d) ==
    /\ held[d] > 0
    /\ pool' = pool + 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![d] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, leaseExp >>

ExpireLease(d) ==
    /\ held[d] > 0
    /\ leaseExp[d] <= clock
    /\ pool' = pool + held[d]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![d] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED << clock, leaseExp >>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << pool, held, leaseExp >>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : AcquireLease(d) \/ RenewLease(d) \/ ReleaseLease(d) \/ ExpireLease(d)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RECURSIVE SumHeld(_)
SumHeld(D) ==
    IF D = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in D : TRUE IN held[x] + SumHeld(D \ {x})

CreditsConserved == pool + SumHeld(Drones) = Total
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2}
    Total = 2
    LeaseLen = 2
    MaxT = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CreditsConserved
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares a fixed pool of patrol-time credits that authorize flight. A drone acquires credits by taking a time-bounded lease from the shared pool: each lease moves one credit from the pool into the drone's hold and stamps an expiry deadline. The credits are strictly conserved: at every moment the credits left in the pool plus the credits held across all drones equal the fixed total, and none are ever created or destroyed. Drones are slow-but-reliable: a slow drone may renew its lease before the deadline to keep flying for an arbitrary time, but it never fails in a way that loses credits. A drone can voluntarily release a held credit back to the pool. When a lease's deadline passes, the expiry mechanism reclaims all of that drone's held credits back into the pool, so a slow-but-alive drone that stops renewing simply returns its credits. A global clock advances time, driving expirations.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The credits remaining in the shared pool plus the credits held by all drones always equal the fixed total number of credits.

------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m3p6t0 -------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Students, MaxTerm

ASSUME MaxTerm \in Nat /\ MaxTerm >= 1

NoLeader == "none"

VARIABLES term, leader, crashed, granted, leaderOf

vars == << term, leader, crashed, granted, leaderOf >>

Init ==
    /\ term     = 0
    /\ leader   = NoLeader
    /\ crashed  = {}
    /\ granted  = [s \in Students |-> [enrolled |-> FALSE, by |-> NoLeader, term |-> 0]]
    /\ leaderOf = [t \in 1 .. MaxTerm |-> NoLeader]

Alive == Nodes \ crashed

ElectLeader(n) ==
    /\ leader = NoLeader
    /\ n \in Alive
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term'     = term + 1
    /\ leader'   = n
    /\ leaderOf' = [leaderOf EXCEPT ![term + 1] = n]
    /\ UNCHANGED << crashed, granted >>

LeaderCrash ==
    /\ leader # NoLeader
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < Cardinality(Nodes) - 1
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {leader}
    /\ leader'  = NoLeader
    /\ UNCHANGED << term, granted, leaderOf >>

Enroll(n, s) ==
    /\ n = leader
    /\ n \in Alive
    /\ ~granted[s].enrolled
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![s] = [enrolled |-> TRUE, by |-> n, term |-> term]]
    /\ UNCHANGED << term, leader, crashed, leaderOf >>

AllEnrolled == \A s \in Students : granted[s].enrolled

Halt ==
    /\ (AllEnrolled \/ (leader = NoLeader /\ term = MaxTerm))
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : ElectLeader(n)
    \/ LeaderCrash
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Students : Enroll(n, s)
    \/ Halt

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

EnrollmentsAuthorized ==
    \A s \in Students :
        granted[s].enrolled => (granted[s].by = leaderOf[granted[s].term])
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
    Students = {st1, st2}
    MaxTerm = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT EnrollmentsAuthorized
nl:
A university course-registration service is replicated across several registrar nodes that elect one leader per term to commit enrollments; only the legitimate leader of a term may enroll a student, and no unauthorized node or stale former leader may commit an enrollment. Elections advance a term counter and record which node was the authorized leader of that term. When a student is enrolled, the commit is stamped with the committing node and the current term, and enrollment is permanent thereafter. Any node may crash silently at any moment; if the crashed node was the leader, leadership is vacated and the survivors fail over by electing a new leader in a higher term. At least one node always stays alive so a new leader can be elected. Because every committed enrollment is tagged with its term, the invariant checks that the committer was exactly the authorized leader recorded for that term, so a stale ex-leader or an unauthorized node can never have its enrollment stand.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every committed enrollment was made by the node that was the authorized leader of the term in which it was committed.
